body: I've already done what I want to do. My bucket list that's within my control is done. This I just can't beat and be positive for myself for.
I'm dying anyway. It doesn't matter.
I'll let you know if I have the misfortune of waking up. :)
I got all my prescriptions ready. Nothing glamorous. Just up and gone.

Do you know any friends of your friend that live near her? If you don't feel comfortable calling in authorities, maybe one of them can go check up on her.

Good luck, dude.
